meaning:
1) manna
1a) the bread from Heaven that fed the Israelites for 40 years of wilderness wanderings

elsewhere.note: When the children of Israel saw it, they said to one another, “What is it?” For they didn’t know what it was. Moses said to them, “It is the bread which Yahweh…
but now we have lost our appetite. There is nothing at all except this manna to look at.”
He humbled you, allowed you to be hungry, and fed you with manna, which you didn’t know, neither did your fathers know, that he might teach you that man does…
The manna ceased on the next day, after they had eaten of the produce of the land. The children of Israel didn’t have manna any more, but they ate of the fruit…
You gave also your good Spirit to instruct them, and didn’t withhold your manna from their mouth, and gave them water for their thirst.
He rained down manna on them to eat, and gave them food from the sky.
